thread:
nick: Quick heads-up — ran the weekly link sweep and found ~12 references in docs/getting-started that point at internal S3/Corp URLs (403 for public). Can the doc custodian triage? I opened a branch with a proposed swap to CDN links: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345

docs-bot: Automated link-scan results for `docs/getting-started`:
```
- docs/getting-started/images/diagram.png -> s3://redwood-internal/assets/diagram_v2.png (403)
- docs/getting-started/snippets/setup.sh -> s3://redwood-internal/snippets/setup.sh (403)
- docs/getting-started/architecture.md#infra -> https://internal.redwood.corp/infra (401)
- docs/getting-started/quickstart.md -> s3://redwood-internal/quickstarts/qs-01.md (403)
```

maria: I can take the onboarding page. Will check whether these assets should be public or remain internal. Any preference for filename changes vs keeping originals? :thinking_face:

ben: thanks @maria. If we move to CDN, please also update image alt text and add a short note in the PR description that this is a public asset. Watch the retina variant in design-assets (design-assets/diagram@2x.png).

jess: FYI — infra removed anonymous read from that bucket last week. If images must be public, prefer the CDN or CloudFront with signed URLs. I can help set up signed URL flows if needed.

maria: plan: 1) replace s3 links with CDN paths, 2) update alt text/caption, 3) open PR and run scanner. I'll ping infra only if signed URLs are necessary. Assigning to myself.

nick: could you paste the PR link here when ready? I'll add the docs QA checklist. Also, can we add a small `custodian` field in frontmatter so there's a contact for quick pings?

maria: yes — adding `custodian: @maria` to frontmatter SGTM. Running the scanner again after changes and will post results.

docs-bot: Re-scan scheduled — will post results in ~10m. :white_check_mark:

lina: quick q — should we also sweep `docs/quickstarts`? I can run the scanner there and share findings.

nick: please do. Drop the list here and @maria will coordinate fixes.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345 (replaces s3 -> CDN, adds `custodian: @maria`, updates alt text + caption)

ben: reviewed the PR — left a small comment about alt wording. :eyes:

maria: addressed ben's comment and pushed. docs-bot: re-scan report -> `0 broken links found` for getting-started.

nick: great — thanks everyone. Adding `docs: custodian-rotation` to next retro agenda so we can formalize on-call for doc sweeps.
